channel.title: Treease Changelog
channel.description: New updates and product improvements in Treease.

item.title: Cloudflare Hosting and Richer Feedback Reports
item.description: Treease moved web delivery onto Cloudflare, tightened graph render ownership, and made feedback reports more useful with optional contact details and file uploads.

item.title: Clearer Usage and Subscription Management
item.description: Account usage is easier to understand, anonymous usage now appears in the account menu, and subscription changes are handled more reliably end to end.

item.title: Feedback, Changelog, and Discoverability
item.description: Treease added an in-app feedback dialog and a generated changelog page, while improving search discoverability and graph startup reliability.

item.title: Smoother Large Graph Rendering
item.description: Viewport virtualization and redraw trimming make large graphs faster to navigate, while table layout, request backoff, and cross-origin access are more stable.

item.title: Workers Rollout and Metering Cleanup
item.description: Treease moved its server and asset delivery onto Cloudflare Workers, unified usage metering, improved billing webhook safety, and fixed streaming graph ownership issues.

item.title: Anonymous Accounts, Sharing, and Editor Polish
item.description: Treease improved anonymous account handling, strengthened share-link restore behavior, polished homepage and editor UI, and added a recursive compact operator for nested data cleanup.

item.title: Pricing, Navigation, and Desktop Actions
item.description: Checkout now respects login state, account navigation is easier to use, desktop file actions moved into menus, and Treease added AI credential routing plus prerendered CLI graph pages.

item.title: Faster Trace Imports and Desktop Hosting
item.description: Streamed trace imports are faster, and the desktop app gained workspace hosting support.

item.title: Sharing, Sign-In, and Pricing Flow Update
item.description: Treease shipped a broader pass across auth, sharing, analytics-backed product flows, and pricing.

item.title: More Precise Structural Compare Results
item.description: Structural compare results now point to explicit byte spans, making diffs easier to locate and review.

item.title: More Reliable Graph Startup and Resize
item.description: Graph readiness is more stable, and workspace resizing now stays in sync more consistently.

item.title: Standalone API Service
item.description: Treease now includes a standalone API service for external integrations and hosted workflows.

item.title: Cleaner Initial Example Loading
item.description: The initial example now goes through the full editing pipeline, so first-load behavior matches regular editing more closely.

item.title: URL-Driven Presets and Better Viewer Sync
item.description: Treease added URL-backed editor presets and reusable tutorial pages, while improving graph search, import progress, viewer mounting, drag guidance, and CLI graph rendering.

item.title: CLI Progress and Version Visibility
item.description: The CLI now shows its version in help output and reports asset download progress.

item.title: More Reliable Web Startup
item.description: Web runtime readiness was stabilized to reduce flaky startup behavior.

item.title: Column Navigator Editing Refresh
item.description: Column Navigators received a layout and editing overhaul, with better toolbar polish, safer cell editing rules, cleaner minimap rendering, and fixes for JSON formatting and graph edges.

item.title: CLI Parsing and Version Support Improvements
item.description: The CLI improved version support, parsing reliability, null-input behavior, and command surface, while example switching keeps its highlight state more reliably.

item.title: NDJSON Import, Linked Scrolling, and CLI Upgrades
item.description: Treease added JSONL and NDJSON import support, a scroll-and-reveal sync toggle, a web graph CLI route, and a more discoverable CLI, while fixing YAML parsing, blank-input analysis, compact output formatting, nested expansion, and several render races.

item.title: Initial Release
item.description: Treease launched its first public release as a structured-text graph editor.
